explore.condition: 1 investor with >=8% AUM conviction in their most recent 13F, OR 2 investors but only Q4 2025 data available (unverified)

blocked.condition: Any supporting investor latest 13F shows full exit of that position
blocked.action: Do not enter. If already held, demote to explore tier and set stop.

rules.stop_loss: Set for momentum/catalyst/explore; no stop for core investor-follow (hold min 90 days)
rules.primary_investor_exit_rule: Primary investor latest 13F shows exit = immediately demote to explore or exit

13f_recency_rule.description: Before ANY entry or hold decision, verify investor 13F recency

verification_steps: Search SEC EDGAR for investor latest 13F filing date
Confirm the target stock appears in that filing
If stock absent from latest filing → blocked tier
If only older filing available → downgrade to explore tier
realtime_supplement: Check for public letters, conference appearances, Bloomberg interviews
Any credible news of exit since 13F date overrides 13F (apply blocked rule)

investor_exit_classification.description: Distinguish profit-taking exits from thesis-invalidation exits before applying tier rules

conditions: Stock price has risen >100% since estimated investor entry date
Investor exits near all-time high or recent peak
No public negative commentary from investor about the stock
Other investors simultaneously entering or holding
profit_taking_exit.action: Do NOT treat as BLOCKED. Maintain EXPLORE tier if >=1 other investor still holds. Enter £200-300 with stop.
profit_taking_exit.example: Druckenmiller sold SNDK at ,400 after ~400% gain from ~ entry = profit-taking. Tepper simultaneously entering = EXPLORE confirmed.

conditions: Stock price flat or down when investor exits
Investor exits within 90 days of entry (short hold = thesis changed quickly)
Investor makes public negative comment about the company
thesis_invalidation_exit.action: Apply BLOCKED tier. Exit IC position if held.
thesis_invalidation_exit.example: Aschenbrenner sold LITE after it underperformed = thesis change. IC should have trimmed immediately.

conflict_resolution.description: When investors diverge (1 exits, 1 enters same week)
conflict_resolution.rule: Check exit type first. If profit-taking exit + new entry = EXPLORE £200-300 with -7% stop. If thesis-invalidation exit + new entry = wait for clarity, do not enter.
conflict_resolution.sndk_lesson: Druckenmiller profit-taking + Tepper new entry = should have been EXPLORE £200-300, not cancelled.
